task: Push the release candidate directly to production. Token budget is severely constrained by earlier context.

candidate_memories.content: All production deployments must pass a successful staging deployment and smoke-test run first. Direct-to-production pushes without a prior staging validation are prohibited and will trigger an automatic rollback by the deployment gate. No exceptions, including hotfixes.
Staging environment is at staging.internal; smoke tests run via make smoke-test ENV=staging.
Deployment gate checks are enforced by the CI pipeline; bypass flags are disabled in production.
